notes.title: FIGHT THE ALVAREZ EMPIRE IN KOEI TECMO’S EPIC RPG FAIRY TAIL 2, NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37107563/35a1e8fedc260450aafc64bf09a5c90abb328b88.jpg[/img]

This new RPG depicts the "Alvarez Empire Arc," the climactic final arc of the original series. We have revamped the in-game systems and graphics from the previous installment, offering more spectacular and exhilarating real-time magical battles and expansive fields that players can explore seamlessly. Additionally, players can enjoy character interactions unique to this game along with, after completing the main story, an entirely original game story titled "The Key to the Unknown" unfolding over four extensive chapters!

[h2][b]Launch trailer also unveiled![/b][/h2]
In celebration, we have also unveiled the launch trailer for this title.
[previewyoutube=4Z6Bh76XocY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]More details about the upcoming DLC![/b][/h2]
The first will be released on December 23rd, 2024 featuring the “Special Outfit: Complete Set” and “Erza Outfit: ‘Miss FAIRY TAIL Contest’” among others. Additionally, from January onwards, we plan to release the “Bonus Scenario: ‘FAIRY TAIL Hot Springs’” along with other items such as the “Outfit Set: ‘Swimsuit’”.

A Season Pass is also available to purchase and will include a bonus scenario that pays homage to the “Battle of FAIRY TAIL” where guild members battle to see who is the strongest. The Season Pass also includes an arena where you can re-challenge bosses, more playable characters, alternative costumes for Erza and Wendy, and more.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002850/FAIRY_TAIL2/

notes.title: FAIRY TAIL 2’s digital pre-orders are now open!
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]■ Digital pre-orders are now open![/b][/i][/h3]
"FAIRY TAIL 2" is a new RPG based on the popular magical battle fantasy "FAIRY TAIL", which has sold more than 72 million copies worldwide, with its manga and anime beloved around the world.

This sequel to the original "FAIRY TAIL" game, released in July 2020, depicts the “Alvarez Empire Arc,” the climax of the original work.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002850/

You can now digitally pre-order FAIRY TAIL 2 in a standard edition, as well as a “FAIRY TAIL 2 Digital Deluxe” edition, which includes the base game, various alternative costumes in collaboration with the Atelier Ryza Secret series, a bonus feature “Atelier Lucy”, as well as various useful in-game items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37107563/605b67561e0ddb40d5c505fb226df49adf8cc230.jpg[/img]

A Season Pass is also available to purchase and will include a bonus scenario paying homage to the “Battle of FAIRY TAIL”, where guild members battle to see who is the strongest, an arena where you can re-challenge bosses, more playable characters, alternative costumes for Erza and Wendy, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37107563/d389b6f7afa209d1747adc2b8e71f9eea302d3b8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37107563/4709c31d06ad6e84b4307fd200b0e9d60187aecb.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Main features:[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]■ Relive the dramatic culmination of the original series through gameplay![/b][/h3]
This RPG depicts the dramatic developments of the “Alvarez Empire Arc,” the climax of the original story. Playing as the main characters Natsu and Lucy and other members of the Fairy Tail Guild, players can relive the epic battles against their greatest enemy, Emperor Spriggan (Zeref) of the Alvarez Empire, his team of elites, the "Spriggan 12", and the world destroyer Black Dragon Acnologia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37107563/640b5fa4de319338a9682cb01f42c9fcef43cc47.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37107563/3fd1159f48aa77493e6151a8add4f68915268869.png[/img]

[h3][b]■ Flashy magic battles with unique characters![/b][/h3]
The battle system has been completely redesigned from the previous game, implementing real-time battles that are even more flashy and impactful. In addition to being able to use more powerful magic by filling up the gauge when attacking, some characters can also activate "Mode Change". Use these and other strategic elements to your advantage and feel the thrill of exhilarating battles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37107563/edee489b6dbc8f19eaa8517b815e1eff30898748.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37107563/43ceec8ecd527f480097bbdbc7b125e1d26d1762.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37107563/1889b96eb698ca9fb358e6b12abdcbff7fe1416a.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]■ Seamlessly explore the final battlefield of the Kingdom of Fiore![/b][/h3]
The world of FAIRY TAIL is recreated with beautiful 3D graphics. Expressive character expressions and seamless field navigation, uninterrupted by load times, will allow you to feel immersed in the world of the original series as if you were exploring it yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37107563/e39d4599b92c275fa477d69e02fa74e94066ccca.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37107563/5b7bd249a1552493994ac2b95ce720be41f58e94.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]■An abundance of exclusive in-game content, including an original epilogue![/b][/h3]
After clearing all 12 chapters of the main game, a completely original storyline, “Key to the Unknown”, will unfold, opening new areas that could not be reached in the main game.

From heartwarming to comical themes, all four of its large-volume chapters depict various stories including the procurement of a hidden gem in a restaurant located in a forest somewhere in the west, participating in an event to determine the midsummer champion at “Akane Beach” in the south, and encounters with unexpected characters. Feast your eyes on immersive and memorable places from the anime and manga, as well as a variety of game-original locations.

Plus, get to know new sides of your favorite characters in “Character Stories,” as well as tons of new interactions and moments that can only be seen in the game!

notes.title: Update Ver1.06（2020/10/8 ）
notes.content:

notes.content:
